challenge.method: Inspected both contiguous publisher ranges for the edition heading, Section 9 wording, final substantive sentence and any appended notice. Tested the separate notice heading and the 72-hyphen separator.
challenge.results: Section 9 locates governing law in “the jurisdiction specified in a notice contained within the Original Software” and litigation in courts in “the jurisdiction and venue specified in a notice contained within the Original Software”. limitations: The finding covers the specified Oracle response. A project-specific California notice requires separate source evidence. Downstream applicability, canonical admission, standalone redistribution and publication are outside scope.
